title: Profile system — placement and tuning profiles
description:
Implement the placement + tuning profile system per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §15. Profiles change defaults, analyzer weighting, labels, and recommended ranges — they must not impose hidden processing.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §15.1 placement profiles (Guitar DI / Pre-Amp, Post Amp / Cab, Rhythm Guitar, Lead Guitar, Stereo Guitar Bus, Active Bass, Distorted Bass)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §15.2 tuning profiles (E Standard through Drop E; 7/8-string; 4/5-string bass; custom fields: string count, open-note pitches, fret range, concert pitch, capo/transposition)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h profileIndex, tuningIndex (read only)
- Source/StateManager.h for how non-param state might be referenced later (read only — do not edit)
- Source/UI/NoteRulerData.* or pitch modules if they expose tuning hooks (read only)

Implement Source/Profiles.h and Source/Profiles.cpp:
1. PlacementProfile enum/id + table of named factory placement profiles covering all §15.1 entries with: display name, category label, recommended analyzer weighting hints (data-only floats/flags), recommended default parameter seed ValueTree or structured DefaultSeed (band/stage hints, Tight Cut / Chug emphasis flags), recommended parameter range metadata (min/max guides — not hard clamps that hide processing).
2. TuningProfile: factory tunings listed in §15.2 as structured records (name, stringCount, openStringMidiOrHz array fixed max ≥8, fretRangeMin/Max, concertPitchHz default 440, capoSemitones, transpositionSemitones). CustomTuning mutable record with same fields and setters.
3. ProfileCatalog (or free functions): listPlacementProfiles(), listTuningProfiles(), getPlacement(id/index), getTuning(id/index), findByName. Index order stable and aligned with profileIndex/tuningIndex intended use (0-based contiguous).
4. applyPlacementDefaults(APVTS&, placementId) optional helper that only writes documented default seeds when explicitly invoked — never continuous hidden modulation. No audio processing in this module.
5. Serialization helpers: placement/tuning id + custom tuning fields to/from ValueTree/XML properties for host state (k.4/StateManager may call).
6. No heap in hot paths; catalogs are static or constructed once on message thread.

Do not write factory preset files, Processor/Editor, CMakeLists, or tests. verification_commands left empty.
acceptance_criteria: All §15.1 placement profiles are named and queryable by stable index/id
All §15.2 factory tuning profiles are present with string count and open-string pitch data; custom tuning fields are supported
Profiles expose defaults/analyzer weighting/labels/recommended ranges only and do not implement DSP or hidden continuous processing
Catalog list/get APIs are index-stable for profileIndex/tuningIndex consumption
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: implement audio DSP or processBlock code

allowed: static constexpr tables for factory profiles
ValueTree or POD structs for seeds and tuning arrays
optional APVTS default seed apply helper on explicit call
forbidden: hidden processing that alters audio without user params
